subject: POV scope + TCO cliffnotes for cross-region analytics stack
messages:
From: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>
To: Jessica Liu <jessica@stellardata.com>, Brian O'Connor <brian@metabase.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 10 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: POV scope + TCO cliffnotes for cross-region analytics stack

Team —

Thanks for the quick sync last week. Follow-up items here so we can lock the POV scope and make sure procurement has the numbers they need for the upcoming commit window. High level ask: run a 3-week POV that validates performance for cross-region reads (us-west<>us-east), verifies KV/cache warmup behavior for our typical 10–30s sessions, and produces a TCO summary we can plug into the board packet.

Please see attached: a first draft POV scope and a small TCO worksheet (cross-region_tco_cliffnotes.xlsx). Key internal success criteria I want captured in the POV:
- 95th pct latency for 1k concurrent inference-style ad-hoc queries under 250ms on median hardware
- Incremental egress and storage cost breakdown by region and storage tier
- Behavior under KV-cache miss rates of 5–40% (we'll provide a synthetic workload)

Laura/Monica — procurement needs any standard contract terms or purchase order lead-time constraints noted before we start. Jessica/Brian — can you confirm you can provide per-region cost slices (storage, egress, compute), and slot availability for a POV starting 24 Aug?

Thanks,
David
David Kim
Head of Platform Partnerships
Redwood Inference

Attachments: POV_scope_and_success_criteria.docx, cross-region_tco_cliffnotes.xlsx
From: Jessica Liu <jessica@stellardata.com>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 11 Aug 2026 11:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POV scope + TCO cliffnotes for cross-region analytics stack

David/Laura/Team —

Appreciate the clear scope. Stellar Data can run the POV starting the week of 24 Aug; we have a 3-node cluster reserved for that window and can mirror your synthetic workload. Confirming we will deliver:
- Per-region compute/slot pricing (on-demand + reserved model)
- Detailed egress matrix (us-west <-> us-east) with sample cost for 100TB/yr patterns
- Low-level query latency traces and KV-cache hit/miss breakdowns
- A short 1-page executive TCO write-up and the raw XLS with assumptions

I'm attaching our POV checklist and a preliminary quote (metabase-pov-quote.pdf). On contract: our standard PO terms are 30 days net; for POVs we generally issue an SOW for services and a temporary license. If procurement needs shorter terms/NDAs first, contracts@stellardata.com can spin that up — copied here.

Two quick asks from our side:
1) Can you provide the synthetic workload file (query sets + session patterns) by Friday the 13th?
2) Any compliance artifacts needed for the POV (SOC2 summary, IP terms)? We can supply a light SOC2 summary for the POV.

Thanks,
Jessica Liu
Senior Solutions Engineer, Stellar Data
jessica@stellardata.com

Attachments: metabase-pov-quote.pdf, POV_checklist.pdf
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Jessica Liu <jessica@stellardata.com>
Cc: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 13 Aug 2026 09:43:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POV scope + TCO cliffnotes for cross-region analytics stack

Jessica —

Thanks — POV start date and deliverables sound good. Monica and I reviewed the quote; two procurement/contract notes before we confirm SOW:
- We need an explicit line item for cross-region egress in the SOW (not buried in appendix) so finance can forecast Q4 spend.
- SLA for data retention and deletion after the POV (7 day retention post-POV unless we request otherwise).

Monica — can you confirm whether 30-day net is acceptable for a vendor SOW of this size? If not, flag what we can do (short-term credit hold, or limited prepayment).

David/Marcus — technical ask: Marcus will own the synthetic workload generation. Marcus, can you post the workload file to the Drive link and tag Jessica by EOD 8/13? That file should include:
- 3 query mixes (ad-hoc analytical, short SELECTs, KV-cache warmups)
- Session interarrival times and concurrency envelope (we typically do 1k, 2k, 5k simulated users)

I'll attach the redlined POV scope once I clean up the contract language.

Laura Bennett
Sr. PM, Platform Ops
Redwood Inference

Subject: Fwd: POV scope + TCO cliffnotes for cross-region analytics stack

Forwarding workload artifacts (single-file attachment) — per Laura's notes I've uploaded the synthetic workload to the shared Drive link and included the runbook. Quick summary below:
- Files uploaded: pov_query_sets.tar.gz (contains 3 mixes), session_profiles.json (concurrency and interarrival params), runbook.md
- Run window: 24 Aug – 11 Sep (3 weeks) with a 2-day ramp and 2-day teardown
- Experiment phases: baseline, KV-cache stress (40% miss), steady-state cross-region read test

Jessica — I confirmed the test harness emits per-query timing and headers so you can map to your KV/cache logs. If Stellar needs a short handoff call, I'm available Mon 8/23 9–11am PT.

Marcus Lin
Staff Software Engineer, Serving Runtime
Redwood Inference
